connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x… private key of a dedicated hot wallet holding USDC on Base mainnet; each tool call pays for itself. Omit to run in quote mode (tools return prices and payment requirements instead of data).

env.name: X402_MAX_PRICE
env.description: Maximum USD price per call; more expensive tools are refused before any payment. Default 0.50 (10x headroom — prices currently range $0.001-$0.05); lower it to cap spend harder.
